title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: the cote studies a category C of 'half-simplicial' (semi-simplicial, i.e. face maps only) complexes that are '∂-perfect', with a view to multiplicative structures. On the previous page Grothendieck isolates two families of objects. The Ψ^i (i ≥ 0) are elementary objects. The 𝔏(i,n) are non-split extensions 0→Ψ^{i-1}→𝔏(i,n)→Ψ^i→0. He computes Hom(Ψ^i, 𝔏(j,n)): it is 0 for j ≠ i+1, and for j = i+1 it is generated by the canonical map Ψ^i→𝔏(i+1,n). He then adds axiom (d): every object of C is a finite iterated extension of objects 𝔏(i,n) (n ≥ 1), or Ψ^j.

This page draws a two-step conclusion.
1. Let A be the full subcategory of C on the 𝔏(i,n) and the Ψ^i. Then C is known up to equivalence once A is known. The justification is the density argument written out on the next page: if every X in C is a colimit in C of a diagram in A, then the restricted Yoneda functor C → Â = Hom(A^op, Set) is fully faithful. In the additive case one can use C → Â_ab, which is also fully faithful because the forgetful functor Â_ab → Â is faithful. If moreover every X is a limit of objects of A, the essential image can be cut out inside Â or Â_ab. Grothendieck says 'nous n'insistons pas'.
2. The Hom computations of the previous page determine A together with its (semi-)additive structure. He declines to spell out composition as 'évidente'. Hence the half-simplicial additive category of ∂-perfect complexes is completely determined: a dévissage / structure theorem by generators and relations.

He then names the next, more interesting tasks: make use of this dévissage to determine the ⊗-structure (multiplicative structure) and the operations Ψ^i on C. This matches the second half of the title, 'structures multiplicatives'.
errors: No mathematical error on the page. There is a gap: step 1 (C determined up to equivalence by A) needs more than the density statement. Fully faithfulness of C→Â gives C up to equivalence only once the essential image is characterized. The next page only begins this ('l'image essentielle ... est contenue dans ...'), and Grothendieck explicitly does not insist.

The passage from 'every object is a finite extension of objects of A' to 'every object is a colimit (or limit) of a diagram in A' is not automatic for extensions. It needs something like a cokernel/kernel presentation by objects of A, i.e. A being generating and cogenerating in a suitable sense. This is left implicit.

ideas.what: A category whose objects are all built from a small full subcategory A (here by finite extensions/colimits) is recovered from A via the restricted Yoneda embedding C→Â (or Â_ab in the additive case).
ideas.modern_name: Dense subcategory / density theorem; reconstruction from a generating subcategory (Gabriel–Mitchell / Freyd style)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Isbell (1960), Ulmer, Gabriel–Ulmer; Mitchell, Freyd for the additive versions
ideas.where_published: Dense/generating families and Â appear in SGA 4 Exposé I; the density argument also recurs in Pursuing Stacks

ideas.what: Structure theorem: the category of ∂-perfect half-simplicial complexes is determined by explicit generators Ψ^i, 𝔏(i,n) and their Hom-groups (Hom(Ψ^i, 𝔏(j,n)) nonzero only for j = i+1).
ideas.modern_name: Presentation of an additive (or Krull–Schmidt-type) category by indecomposables and morphisms; dévissage by iterated extensions
ideas.usually_credited_to: General technique (quiver/representation-theoretic presentation); no specific attribution for this category

ideas.what: Programme: use the dévissage to determine the tensor structure and the operations Ψ^i on ∂-perfect semi-simplicial complexes.
ideas.modern_name: Monoidal/λ-ring (Adams-type operations) structure on a combinatorial model of complexes

missed.claim: Grothendieck states as the next interesting step the determination of the ⊗-structure and the Ψ^i operations from the dévissage, but this page does not carry it out.
missed.quote: faire cas d'un dévissage de la ⊗-structure et les opérations Ψ^i
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: An explicit generators-and-relations description of the monoidal structure (and of Adams-type operations) on semi-simplicial ∂-perfect complexes could relate to current work on semi-simplicial/Δ_inj models and power operations. This page alone does not show what he obtained.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a transitional summary. It invokes a standard density argument to say the category is determined by an explicitly computed subcategory, and announces the multiplicative programme. It contains nothing beyond routine category theory; any novelty lies in the specific category, which is described elsewhere in the cote.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'En vertu de ce qui suit,' — likely 'En vertu de ce qui précède,' (unsure).
Line 2: '1. A est la sous-catégorie pleine' is more likely '1. si A est la sous-catégorie pleine'.
'engendrée par les 𝒪(-)' should almost certainly read 'formée par les 𝔏(i,n)' (the objects from the previous page), followed by 'et les Ψ^i'.
'à équiv. près (dit: nous n'insistons pas)' is more likely 'à équiv. près (cf. ci-dessous; nous n'insistons pas)' or similar.
'on choisit de décrire la composition' is more likely 'on s'abstient de décrire la composition des morphismes, qui est évidente'.
'catégorie [?] ½ simpliciale additive des ∂-parfaits' is more likely 'la catégorie additive des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂-parfaits' (the line contains '½ simpliciaux').

Final paragraph: 'Les deux restrictions : faire usage d'une détermination de la structure et les opérations Ψ^i' is more likely 'La chose intéressante : faire cas d'un dévissage de la ⊗-structure et [de] les opérations Ψ^i' (the symbol before '-structure' looks like ⊗).
